_comment: The programs that show the speaker button (read aloud, with or without the arrow for 'from here on'). The one list the sync script (scripts/sync_speaker.py) reads; a program that starts to read aloud comes in here, and a copy that is not in it never gets the button. Paths are relative to the folder that holds the repos next to this one.

buttons.name: TTS-Suite
buttons.uses: src/tts_suite/service/ui/speak.js and speaker-icon.js (the page's test reading) read speaker/ itself
